lines.text: كان للقمر مَكْث فإِنّك تُخْرِج اجزاء{n:1} الجَدْوَل الرابع من حدّ سمت الغارب من بَدْء المكث ومن
lines.plain: كان للقمر مَكْث فإِنّك تُخْرِج اجزاء الجَدْوَل الرابع من حدّ سمت الغارب من بَدْء المكث ومن

lines.text: حَدّ سمت الجُزْء الطالع في بَدْء الانجلاء الى جهة عرض القمر فحيْثُ انْتَهَى بك العَدَد من دائرة
lines.plain: حَدّ سمت الجُزْء الطالع في بَدْء الانجلاء الى جهة عرض القمر فحيْثُ انْتَهَى بك العَدَد من دائرة

lines.text: الافْق فهو سَمْت الظُّلْمَة والانجلاء الذي يحدُث في دائرة القمر. وهذه صورة الكُسوف على جهته
lines.plain: الافْق فهو سَمْت الظُّلْمَة والانجلاء الذي يحدُث في دائرة القمر. وهذه صورة الكُسوف على جهته

lines.text: وجهات الظلْمة فيه والانجلاء إِن شاء اللّٰه.
lines.plain: وجهات الظلْمة فيه والانجلاء إِن شاء اللّٰه.

lines.text: *قال نَبْدَأُ بعَوْن اللّٰه فنخُطّ{mL:5}{mR:f. 105,r.}
lines.plain: *قال نَبْدَأُ بعَوْن اللّٰه فنخُطّ

lines.text: خَطًّا مستقيمًا ونقسِمه بأَقسام
lines.plain: خَطًّا مستقيمًا ونقسِمه بأَقسام

lines.text: متساوية كم شِئْتَ بَعْدَ أن يكون
lines.plain: متساوية كم شِئْتَ بَعْدَ أن يكون

lines.text: مثل عَدَد نِصْف القُطْرَيْن او
lines.plain: مثل عَدَد نِصْف القُطْرَيْن او

lines.text: اكثر منه ثمّ خذ من هذا الخطّ
lines.plain: اكثر منه ثمّ خذ من هذا الخطّ

lines.text: بقدر نصف القطربْن فأَدِرْ به{mL:10}
lines.plain: بقدر نصف القطربْن فأَدِرْ به

lines.text: دائرة وهي دائرة نصف القطريْن
lines.plain: دائرة وهي دائرة نصف القطريْن

lines.text: التي عليها يقَع مَرْكَز القمر في
lines.plain: التي عليها يقَع مَرْكَز القمر في

lines.text: وقت الابتداء وتمام الانجلاء ثمّ
lines.plain: وقت الابتداء وتمام الانجلاء ثمّ

lines.text: خذ ايضًا بقَدْر نصف قطر الظلّ
lines.plain: خذ ايضًا بقَدْر نصف قطر الظلّ

lines.text: فأدِرْ به دائرة على مركز الدائرة{mL:15}
lines.plain: فأدِرْ به دائرة على مركز الدائرة

lines.text: الأُولَى تقَع في داخِل تلك الدائرة وهي دائرة الظِّلّ ثمّ رَبِّعِ الدائرتَيْن أَرْباعًا متساوية واكتُبْ
lines.plain: الأُولَى تقَع في داخِل تلك الدائرة وهي دائرة الظِّلّ ثمّ رَبِّعِ الدائرتَيْن أَرْباعًا متساوية واكتُبْ

lines.text: على أطراف الخُطوط جِهات المشرِق والمغرِب والشَّمال والجَنُوب ثمّ خُذْ من الخطّ المقسوم ايضًا
lines.plain: على أطراف الخُطوط جِهات المشرِق والمغرِب والشَّمال والجَنُوب ثمّ خُذْ من الخطّ المقسوم ايضًا

lines.text: بقَدْر عرض القمر لوَسَط الكسوف بالمِدْوَار وضَعْ احد طَرَفَيْه على مركز الدائرتَيْن وأدِرْ طَرَفه
lines.plain: بقَدْر عرض القمر لوَسَط الكسوف بالمِدْوَار وضَعْ احد طَرَفَيْه على مركز الدائرتَيْن وأدِرْ طَرَفه

lines.text: الآخر الى جهة عرض القمر فحيْث وقَع من خطّ الشَّمال او الجَنوب فتعلِم عليه عَلامة على الخطّ تكون
lines.plain: الآخر الى جهة عرض القمر فحيْث وقَع من خطّ الشَّمال او الجَنوب فتعلِم عليه عَلامة على الخطّ تكون

lines.text: مَرْكَزًا للقمر لوَسط الكسوف ثمّ خذ من ذلك الخطّ ايضًا بقَدْر عرض القمر لبدْء الكسوف{mL:20}
lines.plain: مَرْكَزًا للقمر لوَسط الكسوف ثمّ خذ من ذلك الخطّ ايضًا بقَدْر عرض القمر لبدْء الكسوف

lines.text: وافعَلْ به مثل ذلك وتعلِم على موضعه من الخطّ في جهة عرض القمر علامة ثانية وكذلك تفعَل
lines.plain: وافعَلْ به مثل ذلك وتعلِم على موضعه من الخطّ في جهة عرض القمر علامة ثانية وكذلك تفعَل

lines.text: بعرض القمر لتمام الانجلاء وتعلِم على موضعه من الخطّ علامة أُخْرَى في جهة العرض ثمّ أَخْرِج من
lines.plain: بعرض القمر لتمام الانجلاء وتعلِم على موضعه من الخطّ علامة أُخْرَى في جهة العرض ثمّ أَخْرِج من

observations: L01, L02, L03, L06, L08, L10, L16, L17, L18, L20: long joins (بَـدْء and ومـن on L01; حَـدّ and مـن on L02; وهـذه and جهتـه on L03; ونقسِمـه on L06; عَـدَد on L08; بـه at the end of L10; تقَـع and داخِـل on L16; جِهـات, خُـذْ and الخـطّ on L17; بقَـدْر, احـد and طَرَفـه on L18; خـذ and لبـدْء on L20) are not transcribed; nor the long kāf of مَرْكَز (L12), واكتُبْ (L16), مَرْكَزًا (L20) and وكذلك (L21).

The page continues chapter 43 and carries its figure. L01 to L03 run the full measure (82 to 505 pt; L01 and L02 reach 508.5 and 506.7 pt); L04 ends the paragraph: it is short (329 to 505 pt) and closed by a full stop. L05 to L15 stand in a column at the right of the page (375 to 505 pt), beside the figure; L05, the first line of the paragraph, is set in (it begins at 481.5 pt, with the asterisk). L16 to L22 run the full measure (80 to 504 pt). Nallino's line numbers 5, 10, 15 and 20 stand in the left margin beside L05, L10, L15 and L20, the first three at the left of the figure. The folio number «f. 105,r.» stands in the right margin beside L05, where the asterisk stands before قال, the first word of the line. Under a rule of 101.5 pt stands one note in a line set in (108 to 154 pt).

The figure of the eclipse of the moon stands at the left of the page, beside L05 to L15 (112 to 335 pt across, 250 to 472 pt down, with its words from 81 to 367 pt and from 231 to 497 pt). It is redrawn: three circles about one centre (radii 110.6, 83.7 and 61.7 pt), the upright and the level diameter of the outermost, three small circles of one size (radius 22 pt) at the upper left, over the centre and at the right, and five more lines; its nineteen letters and words stand where they are printed. The words «جنوب» (over the figure), «مشرق» (at its left), «مغرب» (at its right) and «شمال» (under it) are printed without the article and without signs. The letters: ا and ج at the ends of the upright diameter, ب and د at the ends of the level one, ض on the upright diameter under the second circle, م beside the centre of the small circle at the left, ل, ه and ط on the upright diameter in the small circle over the centre, ح beside the line that runs from the left through the centre, ك beside the centre of the small circle at the right, س under the lines that meet there, ز under the centre, ق where a line meets the outermost circle at the left, and «لا», the lām and the alif in one sign, where a line meets it at the lower right. The letters ل, ه, ح, ط, س and ز touch the drawing in the print.
Note: one line: «1) Cod. اخر» (the Arabic in the small type, read at 900 dpi; the dot of the khā' is printed; no signs). The reference stands after اجزاء (L01).

L10: the print has «القطربْن»: under the tooth after the rā' stands one round dot, joined to the foot of the tooth in the master scan and touching it in the second copy, where القُطْرَيْن (L08) and القطريْن (L11) have the two dots of the yā' in one piece of two lobes (apart from the letter in the second copy); so in both copies. Over the tooth stands a round sukun (2.5 x 2.5 pt, its top 13.7 pt over the baseline), as on L11. Nallino's list of corrigenda gives «القطرَيْن» for this place (p. 154, line 10). The word is kept as printed.

L02: انْتَهَى: between the alif and the tooth of the nūn, above the dot of the nūn, stands a round sukun (2.5 x 2.9 pt, 12.2 to 9.3 pt over the baseline), a solid round mark in both copies; over the alif nothing is printed (no waṣla, where ٱنتهى on p. 151 has it); a fatha low over the tā' (its top 9.3 pt over the baseline), above its two dots, and a fatha over the hā'.

فحيْثُ (L02) and فحيْث (L19): the fā' stands over the ḥā' and its dot stands high (12.9 and 12.6 pt over the baseline); at its left, over the yā', a small round sukun (2.5 x 2.5 and 2.2 x 2.5 pt), solid in both copies on L19; on L02 a damma over the thā' (2.9 x 5.0 pt), beside its three dots; on L19 no damma. Nothing over the ḥā' in either.

The line: الخطّ (L09, L17, L19, L20, L21, L22) and خطّ (L19): a shadda over the ṭā'. On L09 the dot of the khā' is joined to the stem of the lām in the master scan and stands apart in the second copy. On L21 the shadda is joined to the top of the stem of the ṭā' in the master scan and stands apart in the second copy. On L22 only a part of the shadda is printed, in both copies (a crescent of 2.2 x 2.2 pt; a speck beside it in the master scan). فنخُطّ (L05): a damma over the khā' (2.2 x 4.7 pt) and a shadda over the ṭā'. خَطًّا (L06): a fatha over the khā' and over the ṭā' a shadda with the fathatan above it (two marks). الخُطوط (L17): a damma high over the ligature of the lām and the khā' (2.5 x 4.7 pt, its top 17.6 pt over the baseline).

فأَدِرْ (L10): over the alif the hamza with a fatha in one cluster (4.0 x 4.7 pt), a kasra under the dāl and a round sukun over the rā', above its dot. فأدِرْ (L15) and وأدِرْ (L18): the hamza bare over the alif (2.9 x 3.2 and 3.2 x 3.2 pt, the notched form in both copies), the kasra and the sukun.

L16: رَبِّعِ: a fatha over the rā'; a shadda over the bā' with a kasra under it, at the right of its dot; and a second kasra at the left, under the ʿayn (3.6 x 2.2 pt); the two kasras stand at one depth (6.2 to 8.3 pt under the baseline), in both copies.

L18, L20: لوَسَط (L18): a fatha over the wāw and a fatha over the sīn. لوَسط (L20): a fatha over the wāw; over the sīn the master scan has a short stroke of 1.4 x 0.7 pt and the second copy nothing: it is not transcribed. L22: لتمام: no signs; the master scan has a speck over the word (1.1 x 0.7 pt, 12 pt over the baseline), the second copy nothing.

Final yā': with its two dots in في (L02, L03, L12, L16, L21, L22), الذي, وهي (L11, L16) and التي; without dots in الى (L02, L19), انْتَهَى, على (L03, L15, L17, L18, L19, L21, L22), الأُولَى and أُخْرَى. In القُطْرَيْن (L08) and القطريْن (L11) the two dots of the yā' are joined to the letter in the master scan.

The hamza stands over its tooth in دائرة (L02, L03, twice on L11, L15, L16), الدائرة (L15, L16), الدائرتَيْن (L16, L18) and شِئْتَ; on the line in اجزاء, بَدْء (L01, L02), الجُزْء, الانجلاء (L02, L13, L22), والانجلاء (L03, L04), شاء, الابتداء and لبدْء. It stands bare over the alif in أن (L07: 2.9 x 2.9 pt) and أطراف (3.2 x 3.2 pt). With a fatha in one cluster: بأَقسام (4.0 x 4.7 pt), أَرْباعًا (3.6 x 4.7 pt) and أَخْرِج (3.6 x 5.0 pt). With a damma in one cluster: نَبْدَأُ (4.0 x 6.1 pt), الأُولَى (over the lām-alif, 4.0 x 6.1 pt) and أُخْرَى (3.2 x 6.1 pt). Under the alif with its kasra: فإِنّك (one cluster of 3.6 x 5.0 pt) and إِن (L04: two marks, the hamza of 2.9 x 2.9 pt and the kasra of 3.2 x 1.8 pt under it, in both copies). الافْق, الى, او (L08, L19), اكثر, ايضًا, احد and انْتَهَى: no hamza.

L01: مَكْث: a fatha over the mīm and a round sukun over the kāf; المكث: no signs. فإِنّك: a shadda over the nūn. تُخْرِج: a damma over the tā' (2.5 x 5.0 pt, its top 15.4 pt over the baseline), above its two dots, a round sukun over the khā', above its dot, and a kasra under the rā'. الجَدْوَل: a fatha high over the ligature of the lām and the jīm (its top 15.8 pt over the baseline), a round sukun over the dāl and a fatha over the wāw. حدّ: a shadda over the dāl; حَدّ (L02): a fatha over the ḥā' and the shadda. بَدْء (L01, L02): a fatha over the bā' and a round sukun over the dāl; لبدْء (L20): the sukun only.

L02: الجُزْء: a damma high over the ligature of the lām and the jīm (2.9 x 4.7 pt, its top 17.3 pt over the baseline) and a round sukun over the zāy, above its dot. العَدَد (L02) and عَدَد (L08): a fatha over the ʿayn and a fatha over the first dāl.

L03: الافْق: a round sukun over the fā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt), above its dot. سَمْت: a fatha over the sīn and a round sukun over the mīm; سمت (L01, L02): no signs. الظُّلْمَة: over the ẓā' a shadda with a damma above it (two marks, the top of the damma 16.2 pt over the baseline), a round sukun over the lām and a fatha over the mīm; الظلْمة (L04): the sukun over the lām only. يحدُث: a damma over the dāl. الكُسوف: a damma over the kāf; الكسوف (L18, twice on L20): no signs. The full stop after القمر.
L04, L05: اللّٰه: over the second lām a shadda with the upright alif above it (two marks: 3.2 x 2.2 and 1.4 x 3.6 pt on L04, 3.2 x 2.5 and 1.8 x 4.0 pt on L05). On L04 the full stop follows.
L05: نَبْدَأُ: a fatha over the nūn, a round sukun over the bā' and a fatha over the dāl. بعَوْن: a fatha over the ʿayn and a round sukun over the wāw (its top 14.4 pt over the baseline).
L06: مستقيمًا: the fathatan. ونقسِمه: a kasra under the sīn.

L07: شِئْتَ: a kasra under the shīn, the hamza over its tooth with a round sukun above it in one cluster (2.9 x 5.8 pt) and a fatha over the tā'. بَعْدَ: a fatha over the bā', a round sukun over the ʿayn and a fatha over the dāl.

L08: نِصْف: a kasra under the nūn and a round sukun low over the ṣād (its top 9.7 pt over the baseline); نصف (L10, L11, L14): no signs. القُطْرَيْن: a damma over the qāf, a round sukun at the top of the stem of the ṭā', a fatha over the rā' and a round sukun over the yā'; القطريْن (L11): the sukun over the yā' only.
ثمّ (L09, L13, L16, L17, L20, L22): a shadda over the mīm. خُذْ (L17): a damma over the khā' and a round sukun over the dhāl, above its dot; خذ (L09, L14, L20): no signs.

L12: يقَع (L12), تقَع (L16) and وقَع (L19): a fatha over the two dots of the qāf. مَرْكَز: a fatha over the mīm, a round sukun over the rā' and a fatha over the long kāf; مَرْكَزًا (L20): the same and the fathatan; مركز (L15, L18): no signs.

L14: ايضًا (L14, L17, L20): the fathatan; on L17 and L20 it is joined to the top of the alif in the master scan and stands apart in the second copy. بقَدْر (L14, L18, L20): a fatha over the two dots of the qāf and a round sukun over the dāl; بقدر (L10): no signs. الظلّ: a shadda over the lām; الظِّلّ (L16): a shadda over the ẓā' with a kasra under the letter, and a shadda over the lām.

L16: الأُولَى: a fatha over the lām. داخِل: a kasra under the khā'. الدائرتَيْن (L16, L18): a fatha over the tā' and a round sukun over the yā'. أَرْباعًا: a round sukun over the rā' and the fathatan. واكتُبْ: a damma over the tā' and a round sukun over the bā'.

L17: جِهات: a kasra under the jīm; جهة (L02, L19, L21, L22), جهته and وجهات: no signs. المشرِق and والمغرِب: a kasra under the rā'. والشَّمال (L17) and الشَّمال (L19): over the shīn a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks). والجَنُوب: a fatha high over the ligature of the lām and the jīm (its top 14.4 pt over the baseline) and a damma over the nūn (2.5 x 5.0 pt); الجَنوب (L19): the fatha only.

L18: بالمِدْوَار: a kasra under the mīm, a round sukun over the dāl and a fatha over the wāw. وضَعْ: a fatha over the ḍād and a round sukun over the ʿayn. طَرَفَيْه: a fatha over the ṭā', over the rā' and over the fā', and a round sukun over the yā'; طَرَفه: a fatha over the ṭā' and a fatha over the rā'.
L19: الآخر: the madda over the lām-alif; no other sign. فتعلِم (L19) and وتعلِم (L21, L22): a kasra under the lām. عَلامة: a fatha over the ʿayn; علامة (L21, L22): no signs.
L21: وافعَلْ: a fatha over the ʿayn and a round sukun over the lām; تفعَل: the fatha only.
L22: أُخْرَى: a round sukun over the khā', above its dot, and a fatha over the rā'. أَخْرِج: a round sukun over the khā' and a kasra under the rā'.

figures.name: F01
figures.note: the figure of chapter 43 for the eclipse of the moon: three circles about one centre; the upright diameter of the outermost, with ا at its top (the south) and ج at its foot (the north), and its level diameter, with ب at its left end (the east) and د at its right end (the west); three small circles of one size: one at the upper left, with م beside its centre, one over the centre of the figure, about a point of the upright diameter, and one at the right, with ك beside its centre; and five more lines: from the centre of the small circle at the left level to the upright diameter, where ل stands; from that centre to the centre of the small circle at the right; from that centre through the centre of the figure to the outermost circle, where لا stands; from the upright diameter, where ط stands, to the centre of the small circle at the right; and from the outermost circle at the left, where ق stands, through the centre of the figure to the centre of the small circle at the right; with the letters ض, ه, ح, س and ز inside the figure and the words «جنوب», «مشرق», «مغرب» and «شمال» at the top, the left, the right and the foot. Measured with tools_s10/fig_measure.py at 600 dpi (scratch fig/spec998.json): the six circles and the seven lines are least-squares fits to their ink (stroke centres and widths); a line is drawn to its meeting with the fitted circle or with the upright diameter, and at م and ك to the end of its ink. The nineteen letters and words are set at the centres of their printed ink; ل, ه, ح, ط, س and ز touch the drawing and are measured on their ink away from the fitted lines and circles
